executiveSummary: Northwind's evidence identifies material gaps in privileged access, incident notification and subprocessor transparency. Optional administrator MFA and unresolved SOC 2 access review exceptions need attention before approval. Request current penetration testing and recovery exercise evidence, and confirm the offshore support arrangement against your intended data use.

findings.finding: MFA not enforced for privileged accounts
findings.description: Northwind's questionnaire says MFA remains optional for legacy administrator accounts, with enforcement planned for next quarter. Those accounts can still authenticate without the additional factor required by the review.
findings.whyItMatters: A stolen administrator password could give an attacker privileged access to Northwind's freight platform and customer data. The planned rollout leaves exposure until enforcement is demonstrated; assess interim restrictions on those legacy accounts.

evidence.quote: MFA is optional for legacy administrator accounts. Enforcement is planned for the next quarter.

findings.recommendedFollowUp: Please confirm when MFA will be mandatory for every administrator, and provide evidence of enforcement and any interim safeguards.

findings.finding: Breach notification exceeds the 24-hour review target
findings.description: Northwind's security policy commits to notifying customers within 72 hours after confirming a personal data breach. That window is longer than this review's 24-hour initial notification target.
findings.whyItMatters: A slower initial warning from Northwind could delay a customer's investigation, containment and communications about affected logistics data. Agree an escalation route and initial notice timing that fit the customer's response process; the 24-hour target is a review requirement, not a stated legal deadline.

evidence.quote: Customers are notified within 72 hours of confirmation of a personal data breach.

findings.recommendedFollowUp: Can you agree a 24-hour initial breach notification commitment and share your escalation procedure?

findings.finding: Offshore support provider is not disclosed
findings.description: Northwind identifies Harbor Support Services in the Philippines as its offshore support provider but says the provider has not been added to the customer subprocessor register. The register therefore does not reflect the disclosed support arrangement.
findings.whyItMatters: Customers may approve Northwind using an incomplete picture of who supports the platform and where support occurs. Clarify Harbor's data access and processing role so the customer can assess disclosure, contractual commitments and any required transfer safeguards.

evidence.quote: Offshore support is provided by Harbor Support Services in the Philippines. This provider is not yet included in the customer subprocessor register.

findings.recommendedFollowUp: Please update the subprocessor register with Harbor Support Services, its access scope, processing location and transfer safeguards.

findings.finding: SOC 2 exception on privileged access reviews
findings.description: Northwind's SOC 2 summary records two missed quarterly privileged access reviews and says remediation remains open. The submitted assurance material does not show that the missed reviews have since been completed.
findings.whyItMatters: Missed reviews can leave unnecessary or outdated administrator permissions in Northwind's platform. This is an unresolved assurance exception distinct from the MFA weakness; request completed review records and evidence that inappropriate access was removed.

evidence.quote: The SOC 2 report records an exception: two quarterly privileged access reviews were missed and remediation remains open.

findings.recommendedFollowUp: Please share the remediation owner, completion date and evidence that the missed access reviews have been completed.

findings.description: Northwind's questionnaire refers to industry-standard controls but supplies no dated penetration test report for this review. The test date, scope, findings and remediation status cannot be established from the submitted material.
findings.whyItMatters: The customer cannot judge whether independent testing has covered Northwind's current freight platform or whether significant weaknesses remain open. This is an evidence gap, not proof that testing never occurred; obtain a current summary before relying on the assurance claim.

evidence.quote: Industry-standard controls are in place. No dated penetration test report has been provided for this review.

findings.recommendedFollowUp: Please provide the latest dated independent penetration test summary, scope and remediation status.

findings.finding: Recovery exercise has not been evidenced
findings.description: Northwind's policy says an annual recovery exercise is planned, but no completed exercise report has been supplied. The review therefore lacks measured evidence of the platform's recovery performance.
findings.whyItMatters: An outage at Northwind could interrupt customers' logistics workflows without demonstrated recovery times to support planning. A scheduled exercise alone does not validate restoration; request measured results and corrective actions rather than assuming the recovery process has failed.

evidence.quote: An annual recovery exercise is planned. No completed recovery exercise report has been supplied.

findings.recommendedFollowUp: Please provide a completed disaster recovery exercise report with measured recovery times and corrective actions.
